'''Rhoa''' is one of the playable character in the Grand Quest. He was the captain of the Seventh Division of Demon Slayers.

==Debut Appearance==
He appeared in Krantz' squad, acting as the moodmaker of the team, which usually ended up arguing with {{c|Kafka}}.

==In the storyline==
Rhoa was a former scientist in Elgaia Federation, who joined the Summoners' Hall because he believed that everyone should be able to enjoy the summoning arts. Thanks to his knowledge, plus Kafka's research about magic, Summoners' Research Lab was established.

In Ishgria, after the ambush of the demon beast, Rhoa ordered {{c|Krantz}} to go without him. Krantz reluctantly agreed, then left Rhoa alone, entrusting the demon beast in his hands. Unfortunately, {{c|Kafka}} read his suicidal plan and decided to join him in the fight against the demon beast. After the battle, Rhoa fell down along with Kafka, suffering serious injuries. Knowing that they could not make it out of the laboratory they infiltrated on time before the devices exploded, Rhoa perishes along with Kafka, having their last moments together talking about their friendship.

==Personality==
Being a person fond of extremes, as well as stubborn to no end, Rhoa often caught in arguments with those around him, especially {{c|Kafka}}. Despite that, Rhoa is a clever man. According to {{c|Grahdens}}, Rhoa's knowledge of otherworldly technology was incredible, despite his flashy appearance.
